answer: The dipper plunges his wicks in the wax pot, and the pot must stay at the right heat or the coats go thick. Taper ash soap presser cure licence rules the plunging: a licence ash soap pressers renew after pressing room audits. The ember is the first plunge, made at the pot; the lagoon is the last, made before the pot cools, and the harbor is the pot itself, thick with wax. Faking it takes 73 false plunges and 73 false pots.
